description: List memberships held by customers — status (active, hold, complete, cancelled), start/expiration/renewal dates, billed price, active hold. Filter by customer, membership plan, type, status, dates or holds. TeamUp: GET /customer_memberships.

expand.description: Comma-separated related fields to expand into full objects (dot-nested, max depth 4), e.g. customer,event.instructors.

expiration_date_gte.description: Expiration date on or after (date, YYYY-MM-DD).

expiration_date_lte.description: Expiration date on or before (date, YYYY-MM-DD).

fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return (dot notation for nested), e.g. id,name,starts_at.

has_active_hold.description: Only memberships with (true) or without (false) a current or upcoming hold.

start_date_gte.description: Start date on or after (date, YYYY-MM-DD).

start_date_lte.description: Start date on or before (date, YYYY-MM-DD).
